historical_discount_mix.formula: sum(Admin order USD) / sum(Admin order USD + matched ES actual discount USD)
historical_discount_mix.population: identified main-site Coins paid nonrefund nonfraud nontest orders; all platforms combined

history_replay.original_basis_reconciliation: Original v15 N/(N+ES_discount) is preserved separately. Original historical paths use actual code percentage, actual coupon-log USD amount and actual points credit with engine ROUND_UP deduction; current expired-template none projection is never used to validate old N. Every historical replay cash amount must be <= original Admin N. Differences are explicit cash lower bounds, not invented fee functions.
